plans.idea: Keep the original's top-left brand row: small logo top-left with the NEW VIDEO badge top-right, a big two-line headline under them on the same left edge, and the bottle filling the lower half at full width, so it reads top to bottom.

Product first: the bottle sits large at the top, and the NEW VIDEO badge sits right above the headline as its label. The headline is anchored in the lower third and the logo signs off at the bottom-left, like a story-format poster.

A symmetric layout on one centre line: the logo is centred at the top, then the headline, then the bottle. The NEW VIDEO badge sits centred at the bottom where a call-to-action button would go, so it ends the reading order.
